who: Codex GPT-6, main agent with question_native_design and owned_hover_cards lanes
where: Harness question interaction and hover overlay presentation
what: Andrew requested a much prettier question UI/UX and showed the default grey AppKit model/effort tooltip, asking that overlays use the app’s own design.
cost: Generic control stacks lost option explanations and visual hierarchy; system tooltip presentation ignored app typography and repeated metadata.
cause: ask emitted generic Card/Choice/Input composition rather than a semantic interaction. Tooltip data was delegated to AppKit rather than the same Flecs presentation as other overlays.
class: A domain interaction has no native view owner, or a shared UI primitive outsources presentation to a different renderer.
prevention: One typed Question element owns prompt/options/recommendation/input/receipt presentation while the existing REPL owns answer and cancellation semantics. One themed hover-help prefab consumes existing Tooltip data; the native panel is passive as well as the Flecs subtree.
workaround: Standalone native map/mini-window help is outside the main/Flecs hover-card path.
fix: Question controls use associated rich option rows, a full-width shared editor, explicit recommendation confirmation and current-draft submission. Pending typed values share one owner across blur/refocus. Hover cards use a bounded one-shot dwell and generation-checked dismissal/placement. Native input/layout tests and REPL answer tests cover the interaction; a float input test caught an incorrect Flecs namespace lookup and passed after using the prefab resolver.
